subject: Renewal: Private environment capacity uplift & term consolidation
messages:
From: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@stellamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellamed.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice & request: expand private footprint at renewal

Hi Jordan,

We received the renewal notice for our Private deployment due in September. Over the last year our usage has increased significantly across analytics and near-real-time triage workloads. Before we sign the renewal, we need to:  

- Add 3 additional isolated clusters in us-east (analytics, psi, and a small canary cluster).
- Consolidate the 12-month renewal into a 24-month term in exchange for committed capacity pricing.
- Confirm isolation requirements (networking/VPC peering and separate key management) and receive the SOC 2 artifacts.

Can your team put together a coordinated plan (schedule + runbook + pricing) for the expansion and the term change? Procurement will need a formal proposal and a DocuSign-ready contract by July 15 to keep current timelines.

Thanks,
Arjun Rao
Director of Infrastructure
Stella Medical

---
Attachments: stellamed_usage_report_q2.csv (summary), initial_request_notes.txt
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@stellamed.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & request: expand private footprint at renewal

Arjun — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support the 3-cluster uplift and a consolidated 24-month term. I looped in Kimberly (technical), Karthik (capacity/ops) and Marissa (pricing/legal) to scope deliverables.

Quick outline of what we'll deliver by July 8:
- Week-by-week provisioning schedule with canary plan for the small cluster.
- Network/VPC diagram and KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
- SOC 2 evidence package and a short security Q/A.
- Pricing: two proposals (24-month committed discount vs 12-month with staged top-ups) + estimated credits for early termination.

Do you have a preferred blackout window (maintenance or DR test days) in July/Aug we should avoid for cluster seeding? Also confirm the three cluster roles (you listed analytics, psi, canary) — want to ensure node sizing profiles match expected workloads.

I'll be your single-thread owner for the rollout.

-Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@stellamed.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & request: expand private footprint at renewal

Hi Arjun / Jordan —

I pulled an initial runbook and I have a few technical clarifications:

1) Isolation: we recommend separate VPCs per cluster with explicit routing via Transit Gateway (or equivalent). For KMS, if Stella prefers CMKs in AWS KMS we can integrate via key grants; otherwise Redwood can manage keys in a customer-dedicated KMS instance. I'll attach the runbook (redwood_provisioning_runbook_v2.xlsx).

2) Cluster sizing: based on the CPU/RAM profile you shared, the analytics cluster should be 16x A100-equivalent nodes, psi 8x, and canary 2x (burst to 4x during smoke tests). If you'd like to push to smaller instances with higher batch windows we can propose a cost-optimized profile.

3) Cutover cadence: propose phased seeding — seed canary (week 1), deploy analytics (week 3 with mirrored data ingest), then psi (week 5). Each step includes a 48–72 hour canary validation window and fallbacks to current fleet.

I'll need Stella's network CIDR ranges and preferred peering account IDs to provide exact templates.

-Kimberly
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_provisioning_runbook_v2.xlsx (workbook of templates & task owners)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@stellamed.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellamed.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & request: expand private footprint at renewal

Arjun — Jordan —

Pricing summary and commercial ask below (detailed proposal attached as proposal_stellamed_capacity_2027.pdf):

Option A — 24-month consolidated term (preferred):
- Net new committed capacity: $450,000 (covers three clusters as specified).
- Discount: 25% off standard private list pricing for the committed capacity.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for the private environment; procurement credit schedule included in Annex A.
- Early termination: pro-rated repayment schedule with a 90-day notice and a fixed buyout table.

Option B — 12-month + staged top-ups:
- Initial commit: $200,000 for canary + analytics seeding.
- Stage two top-up (psi) invoiced at month 4.
- Less favorable unit rates (about 15% higher) but shorter commitment.

Commercial notes:  
- We can include one professional services credit (up to 40 engineer-hours) for network onboarding as part of Option A.
- If Stella can sign by July 15, we can guarantee August 2 start for the canary window.

Next steps:  
1) Please confirm Option A vs B by EOD July 9 so we can finalize the contract.
2) Procurement: we'll push a DocuSign envelope to procurement@stellamed.com once Option selection is confirmed.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through pricing.

-Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercial Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposal_stellamed_capacity_2027.pdf
From: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@stellamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellamed.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice & request: expand private footprint at renewal

Thanks team — this looks good. Stella prefers Option A (24-month consolidated term). A couple of follow-ups before procurement will clear the DocuSign:  

- Please attach SOC 2 Type II report and redacted penetration test summary to the proposal.
- Confirm the maintenance blackout windows: we prefer weekends in UTC-5 to be avoided for canary smoke tests.
- Can you add the KMS integration diagram to Annex B (we plan to use our own CMKs).

If you can get the updated proposal and DocuSign envelope to procurement@stellamed.com by July 12 we'll aim to countersign by July 20.

Arjun Rao
Director of Infrastructure
Stella Medical
